description: This PHP source file defines the class Image_Graph_Dataset_Trivial, a dataset class for rendering simple point plots in the Image_Graph library. It provides methods to initialize with data, add points, and retrieve point data, serving as a utility for graph visualizations.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_Trivial
classes.description: A dataset class for trivial point data, allowing addition and retrieval of points with ease, used within the Image_Graph library to represent datasets.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_Trivial
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dataset with an optional array of points.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds a data point to the dataset, optionally with associated metadata for HTML image maps.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first point in the dataset.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns the last point in the dataset.

methods.name: _getPointX
methods.description: Retrieves the X value of a point at a given index.

methods.name: _getPointY
methods.description: Retrieves the Y value of a point at a given index.

methods.name: _getPointID
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a point at a given index.

methods.name: _getPointData
methods.description: Retrieves additional data associated with a point at a given index.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of points in the dataset.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the internal pointer for iteration.

methods.name: _next
methods.description: Advances internal pointer and returns the next point.
